process.title: How We Work
process.subtitle: A clear, transparent process with no surprises.
process.step1_desc: We learn about your business, goals, audience, and the needs of your project.
process.step2_desc: We shape the visual direction and structure around your brand and objectives.
process.step3_desc: We build, integrate, and test your website with performance and usability in mind.
process.step4_desc: We run final checks, publish your website, and hand over the agreed deliverables.

services.title: The right solution for your next step
services.subtitle: Clear starting points. Every quote is tailored to the actual scope and complexity of your project.
services.landing_desc: A focused one-page website designed to present an offer and encourage action.
services.landing_scope: One page · 5–10 sections as a starting guide
services.business_desc: A professional website that gives your business room to explain its services and build trust.
services.business_scope: Up to 5 pages as a starting guide
services.ecommerce_desc: A product catalogue and shopping experience adapted to your sales process.
services.feature1: Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop
services.feature2: Navigation, calls to action, and contact forms when agreed
services.feature5: Content management integration when appropriate and agreed
services.feature6: WhatsApp checkout with cart summary or payment-provider integration for e-commerce, as scoped
services.quote_note: Prices are initial reference ranges, not fixed quotes. Final pricing depends on the number of pages and sections, design complexity, content, functionality, and integrations.
services.compare_subtitle: A quick overview of the usual scope. The final proposal will define exactly what your project includes.
services.maintenance_subtitle: Launch support and ongoing maintenance are different services, with different timeframes and purposes.
services.support_desc: After launch, we provide 30 calendar days of support for reproducible defects attributable to the delivered work and reasonable guidance on included features.
services.maintenance_included_desc: From launch, three months of basic maintenance are included, within the monthly time allowance for the corresponding service tier.
services.maintenance_plan_desc: After the included period, you can continue with a monthly plan. Unused time does not roll over; work beyond the allowance is quoted separately.
services.maintenance_ecommerce_time: Up to 4 hours / month · subject to complexity
services.maintenance_includes: Small text, image, and price updates; reasonable image resizing and optimization; basic link and component checks; periodic performance and dependency checks; and minor technical fixes.
services.maintenance_excludes: New pages or features, redesigns, migrations, bulk product uploads, inventory automation, new integrations, and third-party costs are not included.
services.conditions_subtitle: A few important points to keep every project clear from the start.
services.payment_desc: 50% to schedule and begin the project; the remaining 50% upon completion and before final handover or deployment.
services.revisions_desc: Two revision rounds are included. Please send one consolidated feedback list per round. New sections, pages, features, integrations, or major direction changes are quoted separately.
services.content_desc: The client provides approved text, images, brand assets, and other materials. Content creation or sourcing can be quoted separately.
services.hosting_desc: GitHub Pages is the default hosting option when technically suitable. Other hosting and custom domain registration or renewal are quoted separately.
services.scope_desc: The proposal defines the agreed scope. External service fees, payment-provider transaction fees, and third-party outages or changes are outside CAIS control.
services.docs_desc: Review the complete service scope, payment terms, support, maintenance, and project conditions.
services.faq1_a: No. They are starting reference ranges. We confirm the final price after reviewing your pages, sections, content, functionality, and integrations.
services.faq2_a: No. Domain registration and renewal are paid separately by the client.
services.faq3_q: Can my online store manage inventory automatically?
services.faq3_a: Automated inventory management is not part of the standard e-commerce scope. It may be evaluated and quoted as a custom feature.
services.faq4_q: What happens after the included maintenance period?
services.faq4_a: You can choose an optional monthly maintenance plan or request individual work when needed.
services.faq5_q: Do you provide advanced SEO or ongoing marketing?
services.faq5_a: The standard scope includes basic on-page SEO foundations. Advanced SEO strategy, ongoing campaigns, and link building are not included unless separately agreed.
